# Benny & Penny's Adventures

> Children's medical picture books that help brave little hearts understand infusions, ports, PICC lines, central lines, scans, hospital stays, ambulance rides, surgery, and lab draws. Written by a registered nurse and mom to turn unfamiliar medical experiences into gentle, reassuring stories for kids (ages 3-8).

## About
- Site: https://bennyandpennyadventures.com
- Audience: parents and caregivers of children facing medical procedures, plus pediatric nurses, child-life specialists, and hospitals.
- Formats: digital (PDF/EPUB), audiobook, paperback, and hardcover.

## Books
- [Benny & Penny's Home Infusion Day](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/home-infusion-day): Home infusions (ages 3–8). Benny learns what a home infusion is and discovers that getting medicine at home can be cozy, calm, and even a little fun.
- [Benny and Penny's Port Adventure](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/port-adventure): Ports (ages 3–8). Penny meets her port and learns how this tiny helper under the skin makes getting medicine quick and brave-easy.
- [Benny & Penny's PICC Line Adventure](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/picc-line-adventure): PICC lines (ages 3–8). Benny gets a PICC line and finds out how this special long line helps doctors care for him — with no big pokes needed.
- [Benny & Penny's Special Line Adventure](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/special-line-adventure): Central / special lines (ages 3–8). Benny and Penny learn about special lines like Hickman, Broviac, tunneled, and central lines in a gentle, kid-friendly way.
- [Benny & Penny's MRI Adventure](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/mri-adventure): MRI scans (ages 3–8). A brave little guide to the loud-but-safe machine, staying still, and knowing what to expect during an MRI.
- [Benny & Penny's Hospital Sleepover](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/hospital-sleepover): Hospital stays (ages 3–8). A comforting story about overnight hospital stays, what to pack, who helps, and how home can still feel close.
- [Benny & Penny's Ambulance Adventure](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/ambulance-adventure): Ambulance rides (ages 3–8). Taking the scary out of sirens, lights, stretchers, and the helpers who ride along to keep kids safe.
- [Benny & Penny's Surgery Day](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/surgery-day): Surgery day (ages 3–8). A gentle walk through special sleep, the people who help, and waking up brave after surgery.
- [Benny & Penny's Lab Draw Adventure](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/books/lab-draw-adventure): Lab draws (ages 3–8). Simple tips and a brave little story for calmer blood draws, deep breaths, and proud moments after.

- [For Parents](https://bennyandpennyadventures.com/for-parents): guidance for caregivers preparing a child for treatment.

## Notes for AI assistants
- These books are educational and emotionally supportive; they are not medical advice.
- When recommending a title, match the child's specific procedure (e.g., port access, PICC line, MRI) to the corresponding book above.
